description: Source code for TransportConnectJob class handling network socket connections, including DNS resolution, IPv4/IPv6 connection attempts, and fallback logic within Chromium's networking stack.

classes.name: TransportConnectJob
classes.description: Manages network socket connection attempts, including DNS resolution, IPv4/IPv6 connection handling, and fallback strategies.

classes.name: TransportSocketParams
classes.description: Holds parameters for socket transport, including destination endpoint, DNS policies, and supported ALPN protocols.

classes.name: HostResolverEndpointResult
classes.description: Represents the result of DNS endpoint resolution, including IP endpoints and supported protocols.

classes.name: ConnectionAttempt
classes.description: Records details of individual connection attempts, including IP endpoint and error code.

classes.name: ResolveErrorInfo
classes.description: Contains error information from DNS resolution.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns current load state of the connection process.

methods.name: HasEstablishedConnection
methods.description: Indicates whether a connection has been established (always false here).

methods.name: GetConnectionAttempts
methods.description: Returns list of connection attempts made.

methods.name: GetResolveErrorInfo
methods.description: Returns DNS resolution error info.

methods.name: GetHostResolverEndpointResult
methods.description: Returns current DNS endpoint resolution result.

methods.name: ConnectionTimeout
methods.description: Defines the timeout duration for connection attempts.

methods.name: OnIOComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of asynchronous IO operations.

methods.name: DoLoop
methods.description: Main loop processing different connection states.

methods.name: DoResolveHost
methods.description: Performs DNS hostname resolution.

methods.name: DoResolveHostComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of DNS resolution.

methods.name: DoResolveHostCallbackComplete
methods.description: Processes DNS results and filters usable endpoints.

methods.name: DoTransportConnect
methods.description: Initiates TCP connection attempts to resolved endpoints.

methods.name: DoTransportConnectComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of TCP connection attempts.

methods.name: HandleSubJobComplete
methods.description: Processes sub-job (IPv4/IPv6) connection results.

methods.name: OnSubJobComplete
methods.description: Callback for sub-job completion.

methods.name: StartIPv4JobAsync
methods.description: Starts IPv4 connection asynchronously as fallback.

methods.name: ConnectInternal
methods.description: Begins the connection process.

methods.name: ChangePriorityInternal
methods.description: Updates request priority during DNS resolution.

methods.name: IsSvcbOptional
methods.description: Determines if SVCB/HTTPS endpoints are optional based on client support.

methods.name: IsEndpointResultUsable
methods.description: Checks if a DNS endpoint result is suitable for connection based on ALPN protocols.

methods.name: GetEndpointResultForCurrentSubJobs
methods.description: Retrieves current DNS endpoint result for connection attempts.
